title: GallarDesign: human-designed websites, built at AI speed
description: Websites for growing businesses, designed by a person and built fast. Live in 14 days, $0 down, plans from $149 a month, and you own it.
heroText: GallarDesign designs and builds fast, search-ready websites for small businesses. A real designer leads every site, and AI does the heavy lifting, so you're live in 14 days.
servicesIntro: Everything a small business site needs to win customers, without a long contract or a locked-in platform.

reasons.title: Designed by a person
reasons.text: Your site is designed for your business by a real designer, not assembled from a template by a bot.

reasons.title: Built at AI speed
reasons.text: AI handles the repetitive build work, so you're live in 14 days from the day we have your content.

reasons.title: Yours to own
reasons.text: Your content and domain are yours from day one. The site is yours after month 12, or any time by buyout.

reasons.title: Changes in two days
reasons.text: Send a change and it's done within two business days. Post to your blog yourself, any time.

faqs.question: What does $0 down mean?
faqs.answer: You pay nothing to start. The plan is a monthly price for 12 months that covers the design, the build, hosting and edits. If you'd rather pay once, every plan has an upfront price.

faqs.question: What happens after 12 months?
faqs.answer: The site is yours. Starter moves to care at $79 a month and Business to $129, which covers hosting, updates and edits. Growth can stay on as a monthly SEO plan. You can also take the site elsewhere.

faqs.question: Can I leave before 12 months?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can buy out the rest of the year at the build part of your plan for each month left: $70 a month on Starter, $170 on Business and $300 on Growth. Within the first 30 days you get a full refund instead.

faqs.question: How is it live in 14 days?
faqs.answer: The clock starts when we have your content: text, photos and logo. If you don't have them, we help you write and gather them. If we miss the 14 days, your first month is free.

faqs.question: Will I be able to edit the site?
faqs.answer: You can write and publish blog posts and change search titles yourself in a simple editor. For anything else, send us the change and it's done within two business days.

faqs.question: Do you work with agencies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Agencies can hire GallarDesign white label, with their name on the work. See the page for agencies.

ctaText: Send a few lines about what you do and what you need. You'll get a reply within one business day.
